esql_patterns.overview: Reusable ESQL patterns derived from production ACE integration projects. All client-specific names have been replaced with generic equivalents. Always use these patterns as a starting point for new development.

pattern.name: shared_cache_with_expiry
pattern.description: Cache database lookup results in a SHARED ROW variable with a 10-minute TTL. Avoids querying the database on every message while keeping data reasonably fresh. Used in gateway/routing services.

pattern.name: soap_fault_error_response
pattern.description: Prepare a SOAP fault response for error conditions. Sets HTTP 500 status and SOAP fault body. Checks for anticipated faultcode/faultstring set earlier in the flow, falls back to a generic message.

pattern.name: json_error_response
pattern.description: Prepare a JSON error response for REST/HTTP services. Use when the incoming request was JSON-formatted (detected from message parser domain).

pattern.name: audit_environment_setup
pattern.description: Populate the standard audit fields in the Environment tree. Call BuildAudit() from the shared library, then add service-specific fields. This pattern is used at the start of every service flow to initialise correlation tracking and auditing.

pattern.name: database_insert_with_error_handler
pattern.description: Insert a record into a database table using PASSTHRU with parameterised values. Declare an EXIT HANDLER to catch and flag database failures without crashing the main flow.

pattern.name: strip_xml_namespaces
pattern.description: Recursively remove all XML namespace declarations from a message tree. Useful when calling backends that do not accept namespace-prefixed XML.

pattern.name: http_method_routing
pattern.description: Set the outbound HTTP method dynamically based on the inbound method. Used in gateway/proxy flows that need to pass through REST methods.

pattern.name: scheduled_timer_flow
pattern.description: Schedule a recurring flow to run once per day at a fixed time. Used in batch/scheduled integration flows (e.g., daily data sync, file pickup).

pattern.name: email_error_notification
pattern.description: Compose an error notification email. Used in error handler subflows to alert the support team when integration failures occur. The EmailOutput node requires BLOB body and EmailOutputHeader.
